items.title: Small steps still count
items.affirmation: Every small step I take matters. I can move forward gently, without rushing my own journey.

items.title: Rest is part of growing
items.affirmation: I am allowed to rest without guilt. Quiet moments help me return with strength and clarity.

items.title: The light returns
items.affirmation: Even when today feels heavy, I can trust that brighter moments are still possible.

items.title: I belong here
items.affirmation: I do not need to become someone else to deserve connection. I am enough as I am.
items.artDirection: Two gentle wildflowers growing together in a meadow, natural shallow depth of field, no text

items.title: Begin with kindness
items.affirmation: The way I speak to myself matters. Today, I choose words that help me grow.

items.title: Quiet courage
items.affirmation: Courage can be gentle. I can try again, ask for help, and take the next step at my own pace.
